practice: Hold the doorway. Let the frightened one see that you are not leaving.

z: 詛 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Give before you calculate whether you will be thanked. Thanks are not the food. If you require them, you have made a trade, and a trade is not yet a family.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is included. 詛 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Give a thing away that you still like. Do not wait until you are tired of it.

z: 詝 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Wisdom is not silence forever. There is a time to speak. The test is whether the words can be repeated in front of the person, and still be a kindness.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokunxele is included. 詝 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Tell one story tonight in which a person in this house is repaired, not mocked.

z: 詠 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla
line:
Look at the work you have stopped seeing. Name it. The naming is not flattery. It is the return of sight, and sight is the turn.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla is included. 詠 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Ask to be shown a skill you had decided was beneath you. Watch the whole way through.

z: 詡 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Put the glowing thing in another room. Sit where you can be seen. You do not have to be interesting. You do have to be in the house.

practice: Be findable. Tell the house which room you will be in, and be in it.

z: 詢 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
Accountability is the first half. Without it, forgiveness is a fog. The one who broke the trust says what was done, without a speech about why it was almost justified.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is included. 詢 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Decide, and say, whether the person is still a member. Do not leave them in a fog.

z: 詣 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
The oldest writings are full of lament, not because lament is holy by itself, but because love that cannot lament becomes hard. Let the house be soft enough to cry.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is included. 詣 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Leave the empty place unspoken-of only if the grieving person wishes it. Otherwise, speak the name.

line:
Despair often tells the truth about pain and then adds a lie about forever. Keep the truth. Decline the forever. Forever is not a fact available to a person at a window.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is included. 試 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Set one place at the table that despair said was pointless. Eat there.

line:
Accountability remains. Mercy is not the cancellation of truth. It is the decision that truth will not be used as a knife at breakfast for the next twenty years.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, ngezansi kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is included. 詩 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Do one undeserved kindness where you are keeping score. Do not mention the score.

z: 詫 inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu
line:
An elder who has turned anger into protection does not become mild. The wall is still warm. What changes is the face it turns toward. It faces the street, not the cradle.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngaphambili, imithambo, maphakathi eduze, kakhulu is included. 詫 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: When the heat rises, name who you are actually keeping safe. Put your body between the danger and the child. Do not spend the heat on the child.

z: 詬 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's dignity is not the right to be obeyed in every small thing. It is the right to be respected while still listening. The listening is what makes the respect true.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is included. 詬 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Once, take the lower seat on purpose. Let someone in the house finish a story you could have told better.

z: 詭 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
Across generations, envy of the young is fear of being finished. Admiration of the young is how an elder stays in the story without owning it.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokunxele is included. 詭 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Say out loud, in the hearing of the person, the exact good you wished were yours. Then leave it theirs.

z: 詮 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who has been afraid and stayed is a better teacher than an elder who claims never to have shaken. The shaking, survived, is the lesson.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla is included. 詮 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Stay until the scared person is breathing slowly. Do not explain the dark away before you have sat in it.

z: 詰 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
An elder who gives the best piece away is not being careless with the future. The elder is showing the future how a house continues.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu kakhulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is included. 詰 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Pass the best portion first. The first piece teaches the house what it is.

z: 話 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder's stories are a kind of speech that builds or bends a family. Tell the story in which people are repaired. The other story will tell itself.

practice: Speak the true sentence. Keep the second one, the one that only wanted to win.

z: 該 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who still notices the small faithfulness in the house is a gift to the young. The young become what is noticed.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokunxele is included. 該 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Look at one ordinary object they mended or prepared, and say what it cost them.

z: 詳 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder's quiet can be a shelter or a locked door. The young can tell which, by whether they are welcome to come and say nothing beside you.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokudla is included. 詳 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: If your quiet has been a punishment, break it with one gentle sentence and then stay.

z: 詵 inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:
Some breaks end a household. That too can be told with dignity. Forgiveness then is the refusal to poison the years that follow. The children still have to live in them.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, phezulu, ngakwesokudla kakhulu is included. 詵 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: If you were the one who broke trust, say what you did without a speech about why it was almost fair.

z: 詹 inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu
line:
An elder who speaks of the dead by name, without recruiting the young into despair, gives the family its memory and its future in the same breath.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele kakhulu is included. 詹 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Bring food. Take the lower seat. Stay past the moment you become uncomfortable.

z: 詼 inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele
line:
An elder who has looked again, many mornings, is a quiet argument against the lie. Do not turn the elder into a slogan. Let the morning itself be seen.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokunxele is included. 詼 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Make one plan for tomorrow small enough that both of you can keep it.

z: 誂 inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla
line:
An elder who lays down a feud gives the young a future that is not already written. That is one of the last great gifts a generation can give the next.

This is the work of a parent and a child. A successful family is a body that can still use every member. inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla is included. 誂 is included. Neither is asked to disappear so the other can be admired.
practice: Leave one cut unanswered today. Do not announce the leaving.

z: 誄 inhliziyo, ngemuva, ngaphezu komaphakathi, ngakwesokudla kakhulu
line:

practice: Before the second loud sentence, step into the doorway, not toward the person. Let the heat guard the house from outside.

line:
Pride needs an audience and a person beneath it. Dignity needs neither. Hidden inside pride is the refusal to be nothing. That refusal is good. It becomes poison only when someone else must be smaller for it to stand.
